findings.summary: Luna omitted eight official service-specific surfaces linked from the official menu navigation. All are partial, unresolved, or error in accessible extraction, so the current product boundary is incomplete.
The official linked ordering page currently states that no menus are available; the dynamic restaurant-issued menu surfaces cannot support the scout's exact product reconciliations.

No restaurant-issued allergen matrix, ingredients document, allergen legend, or cross-contact disclosure was available. Incomplete menus cannot substantiate frozen complete arrays, negatives, or cross-contact semantics.

verifier.summary: Identity is verified, but independent review found additional official service surfaces and confirmed that the restaurant-controlled catalog remains dynamically inaccessible/incomplete. Luna supplied no current products or presentation IDs to verify. No additional products can be responsibly enumerated, and all frozen food/beverage rows are unobservable rather than absent; their allergen arrays and cross-contact claims remain unavailable. The homepage marketing phrase is an artifact.
